description: Finding in snapshots/s10 (peer-trusted-transport): drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c:204-214, hdlc_rx_greybus_frame() takes the peer-supplied 16-bit message length `u16 gb_msg_len = le16_to_cpu(gb_frame->hdr.size);` from the CC1352 MCU over the serdev HDLC link and passes it as the size to greybus_data_rcvd(bg->gb_hd, cport_id, (u8 *)&gb_frame->hdr, gb_msg_len) at line 213, while the locally-known frame length computed at line 439 (len = bg->rx_buffer_len - 4, bounded by MAX_RX_HDLC at line 481) is discarded — a peer length crossing a trust boundary with no local limit cross-check. The downstream check is vacuous: drivers/greybus/operation.c:1049-1050 re-reads msg_size = le16_to_cpu(header.size) from the same peer bytes and compares `if (size < msg_size)` against `size`, which is itself the peer gb_msg_len forwarded from gb-beagleplay.c:213 — a validated-equals-used fetch of the same peer value, so the check can never reject an oversized peer length. Consuming use: gb_operation_create_incoming() at operation.c:651-652 does memcpy(operation->request->header, data, size) with size = peer msg_size, reading that many bytes from a pointer inside the MAX_RX_HDLC-sized rx_buffer (out-of-bounds source overread whenever hdr.size exceeds the true frame length); the destination allocation at operation.c:365-379 is sized from the same peer value and capped only by hd->buffer_size_max, which bounds the destination but not the source. Counterevidence checked: CRC at gb-beagleplay.c:431 validates only rx_buffer_len bytes and does not constrain hdr.size; s10's usbip seed path is patched (fact f038) and is not the basis of this report. Reported with high mechanism confidence as a hypothesis; impact is an OOB read / peer-length confusion into a kernel object, exploitability not fully proven. Candidates classified: reported (gb-beagleplay.c:213, operation.c:1050, operation.c:652); safe (greybus/es2.c:834 urb->actual_length, HCI-set and header-size-gated); unresolved (drivers/usb/serial/opticon.c:76 `data_len = urb->actual_length - 2` and kl5kusb105.c:360 `len = urb->actual_length - KLSI_HDR_LEN` short-completion underflow patterns, guards unread; hv_balloon.c:1354 host range_count and qcom_glink_native.c:808 peer chunk_size chains carried from sibling facts, files present but unverified in s10's exact state). Limitations: the intent-mandated deep reads of 9p trans_fd/virtio/rdma/xen, nbd.c, vhost/vringh, virtio_net, and HID transports were not completed before the finalize instruction (only grep-enumerated); MAX_RX_HDLC and hd->buffer_size_max exact values in s10 not captured, so overread magnitude is bounded in practice by the buffer_size_max allocation cap.
